scope: Isolated operational integration QA; Production mutations prohibited
sourceFixturePolicy: Generate synthetic repository fixtures. Actual user source may be read privately from an explicit local path; never commit source rows or credentials.

requirements.scenario: Original three-file source proof
requirements.expected: Exact original bytes, three ordinals, raw SHA-256 and 27,278-row full contract survive collect-to-private-staging without rewriting.
requirements.requiredEvidence: actual-source private-path check plus isolated storage roundtrip

requirements.scenario: Request idempotency and global worker concurrency
requirements.expected: Duplicate enqueue/reconnect retains one request identity; two claims and concurrent CAS writes yield one collecting worker/job.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real SQL queue and concurrent HTTP integration

requirements.scenario: Operator and worker authentication boundaries
requirements.expected: Operator session, allowed Origin and worker credential scopes stay distinct. Anonymous, wrong worker, browser worker auth and unauthorized artifacts are rejected.
requirements.requiredEvidence: handler plus isolated private-storage authorization tests

requirements.scenario: Missing or corrupted originals
requirements.expected: Missing part, extra object, size mismatch, SHA mismatch or duplicate SKU cannot reach collected/approval; no operational rows are written.
requirements.requiredEvidence: actual parser and staging finalize failure integration

requirements.scenario: Lease expiry, cancellation and late worker result
requirements.expected: Expired/revoked lease blocks upload-finalize/report and new artifact grants; cancellation before enqueue reply is an atomic request tombstone.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real SQL expiry/CAS plus handler request race

requirements.scenario: Lost finalize response
requirements.expected: Same completed lease replay returns the existing collected result and immutable manifest; no duplicate artifact or job is created.
requirements.requiredEvidence: HTTP success-response loss and retry

requirements.scenario: Full-file preview and strict numeric preservation
requirements.expected: All six field policies are selected. Negative available stock and actual zero prices survive; malformed, absent or fractional integer values block approval.
requirements.requiredEvidence: client/contract/app preview with full-size private or generated fixture

requirements.scenario: Exact baseline before and after comparison
requirements.expected: Current ready state snapshot is distinguished from original carrier; incomplete pagination or a baseline change at any stage blocks approval.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real adapter keyset reads and snapshot-drift integration

requirements.scenario: Bounded preview receipt
requirements.expected: Receipt stores reviewed counts, permitted field policy and source fingerprint only. Raw rows, product/supplier data, forged counts and mismatched baseline are rejected.
requirements.requiredEvidence: actual receipt handler and SQL persistence integration

requirements.scenario: Server approval binds immutable source and policy
requirements.expected: Approval binds job/request, verified manifest/hash, full six-field policy, latest baseline and reviewed fingerprint; client-only assertion cannot grant apply.
requirements.requiredEvidence: approval endpoint and server persistence tests

requirements.scenario: Approval replay and conflict
requirements.expected: Same approval retry is idempotent. Different manifest, baseline, field selection or review identity rejects replay and cannot overwrite an approval.
requirements.requiredEvidence: concurrent SQL approval and client lost-response recovery

requirements.scenario: Default disabled apply and incomplete review
requirements.expected: Unapproved/default-disabled job, unknown comparison, excessive row-count drop or invalid source stays blocked in UI and direct server calls.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real UI plus independent direct endpoint negative checks

requirements.scenario: Full-source application in isolated database
requirements.expected: Authorized isolated full apply stores the complete source universe, promotes one ready snapshot and preserves raw-original provenance. Ready row count equals the reviewed source.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real snapshot SQL plus private storage integration, scaled source fixture

requirements.scenario: Chunk replay and request identity
requirements.expected: Each bounded row chunk and completion retry uses the same upload intent; response loss never starts a second import or silently replaces source identity.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real rows/completion RPC and interrupted transport integration

requirements.scenario: Partial import or completion failure
requirements.expected: Failed chunk/cancelled completion cannot promote partial rows or alter the previous ready source; previously committed staging rows are represented honestly.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real SQL transaction failure and current-source checks

requirements.scenario: Baseline serialization against competing full/patch/inventory jobs
requirements.expected: The existing shared advisory lock and submit-time baseline guard serialize completion; a competing newer baseline rejects stale approval/apply.
requirements.requiredEvidence: PostgreSQL multi-session integration using timeout-branch fixes

requirements.scenario: Ready commit with lost HTTP response and abort race
requirements.expected: Success with lost response remains recoverable by existing intent/snapshot; a ready original cannot be aborted or deleted, and replay cannot duplicate application.
requirements.requiredEvidence: real completion lock plus original-files abort ordering

requirements.scenario: Requested snapshot Matrix rebuild and recovery
requirements.expected: Completion requires the applied snapshot's Matrix result. Pending/failed rebuild is shown accurately and retry rebuild never reimports or reapplies the source.
requirements.requiredEvidence: actual Matrix SQL/status wait, failure and retry integration

requirements.scenario: Operational/manual/system boundaries
requirements.expected: Source full sync preserves system stock/base price, operational master, manual price decisions, links, rules, tags and Picking data; removed source SKUs do not imply silent manual-data deletion.
requirements.requiredEvidence: before/after isolated table and projection checks

requirements.scenario: Existing manual imports and public frontend security
requirements.expected: Manual full/patch and inventory-count flows retain their contracts; browser assets contain no worker credential, service-role secret or source business rows; preview/apply state is truthful.
requirements.requiredEvidence: existing regressions plus app mount/static boundary integration

runtimeReporting.realPostgresAndSupabaseStorage: Report only if actually executed in isolated runtime
runtimeReporting.localPostgresAndPrivateStorageAdapter: Report SQL and protocol coverage separately from Supabase service behavior
runtimeReporting.pgliteAndMocks: Report explicitly as a fallback; do not infer multi-session PostgreSQL or Supabase Storage compatibility
runtimeReporting.productionReadOnlyComparison: Read-only live metadata and hashed-key field comparison; no fixtures or mutation on Production
